name: Bitperfect Player
tagline: AI Enhanced and Bit-for-bit audio playback

pro.name: Bitperfect Player

unlocks.name: Every feature, no tiers
unlocks.desc: Bit-perfect USB output, 32-band parametric EQ, DSP rack, local library, casting and receiver mode. One subscription covers all of it.

unlocks.name: AI Enhancer
unlocks.desc: Rebuilds high frequencies in 44.1 and 48 kHz files, on your phone. Off by default. Full model on a supported neural chip; Lite mode on other phones.

unlocks.name: Sonic Scan and Similar Tracks
unlocks.desc: Finds similar tracks in your library and builds matching queues. Runs offline after a one-time download.
